journeys.behavior: The public Horizonte home renders the primary 'Let's talk' / 'Hablemos' action and the selected-work link without authentication.
preconditions: The site app is ready on its authorized local origin.
No session, fixture, or write is required.
steps: Navigate to / with Computer Use as an anonymous visitor.
Capture the initial viewport.
Observe the primary ticket, the secondary selected-work link, and the project stage.
Capture the final viewport plus console and network observations.
expectedResults: The home renders in the declared locale without a runtime error or not-found state.
The primary and secondary actions are visible.
The route stays on the allowed origin and no write occurs.
journeys.beforeProbe: GET / and record status, final URL, and selected safe headers.
journeys.afterProbe: Repeat the same GET and assert the response and final URL are unchanged.

steps: Navigate to each mapped locale route with Computer Use as an anonymous visitor.

Capture the final viewport plus console and network observations.
expectedResults: Both locales render case-study evidence without a not-found state or runtime error.
The route stays on the allowed origin and no write occurs.
journeys.beforeProbe: GET each mapped route and record status and final URL.
journeys.afterProbe: Repeat the same GETs and assert the responses are unchanged.

journeys.behavior: Unauthenticated navigation to the protected dashboard does not render operations content; the observed redirect target is recorded verbatim at run time.
preconditions: No session exists; this journey never automates login or creates a browser profile.
Production remains read-only.
steps: Navigate to /dashboard without a session using Computer Use.
Capture the observed response, final URL, and visible state.
Assert no Overview, Leads, Projects, Resume, or Settings content rendered.
expectedResults: The protected route never renders dashboard content anonymously.
The observed redirect is recorded exactly as seen; the exact sign-in origin is not claimed until evidence exists.
journeys.beforeProbe: GET /dashboard and record status and final URL without following the redirect.
journeys.afterProbe: Repeat the same GET and assert the observed state is unchanged.

journeys.behavior: An authorized dashboard operator opens Overview and observes the operational readiness checklist without mutating anything.

steps: Navigate to /dashboard/ with the existing authorized session only.
Observe the readiness checklist and the next trustworthy action.
Capture discriminating screenshots plus console and network observations.
expectedResults: Overview renders its five sections without an unexpected runtime error.
No data changes and unrelated records remain unchanged.

journeys.beforeProbe: Record the visible checklist sections and console error count.
journeys.afterProbe: Repeat the same observation and assert the checklist state is unchanged.

Production remains read-only.
steps: Navigate to /dashboard/leads with the existing authorized session only.
Observe the contact-request list and its status values.
Capture discriminating screenshots plus console and network observations.

No record is created, edited, or deleted; any future mutation requires sideEffectMode authorized-writes with a run-scoped fixture, before/after probes, cleanup, and a host authorization receipt outside this repository.

journeys.behavior: An authorized operator saves a resume edit, and the server rejects content that breaks the resume contract before writing.
preconditions: An authorized existing Better Auth browser session for the dashboard operator exists; login is never automated and no profile is created.
Runs on local or preview only; production stays read-only.
The original resume draft for the selected locale is recorded before the run.

The selected resume draft for the selected locale already has unpublished changes (publishedAt unset), because a dashboard save clears publishedAt and cleanup cannot restore a published state; otherwise the run stops.
steps: Open /dashboard/resume with the existing session.
Change one summary line to a run-scoped marker and save.
Set the PDF href field to javascript:alert(1) and save.
Restore the original content and save.
expectedResults: The valid save shows 'Resume saved' and the draft updatedAt advances.
The invalid save shows 'Resume save failed' with the server message and the draft updatedAt does not change.
After cleanup the draft content equals the recorded original.
journeys.beforeProbe: Record resumeDrafts.updatedAt and contentJson hash for the locale.
journeys.afterProbe: Read the same draft and compare updatedAt and contentJson hash with the expected values.
journeys.cleanup: Save the recorded original content for the locale and confirm the contentJson hash matches. Residual effect, recorded in the evidence: updatedAt (the visible 'Last saved') advances, because the save handler always stamps a new time.

journeys.behavior: An authorized operator edits and saves a project draft and sees the saved state.
preconditions: An authorized existing Better Auth browser session for the dashboard operator exists; login is never automated and no profile is created.
Runs on local or preview only; production stays read-only.
The original draft for the selected project and locale is recorded before the run.
The selected project draft already has unpublished changes (publishedAt unset), because a dashboard save clears publishedAt and cleanup cannot restore a published state; otherwise the run stops.
A caseStudyMetadata row already exists for the project, because each save patches it (or inserts one when absent); otherwise the run stops.
steps: Open /dashboard/projects with the existing session.
Change the summary of one project draft to a run-scoped marker and save.
Restore the original summary and save.
expectedResults: The save succeeds and the project draft updatedAt advances.
After cleanup the summary equals the recorded original.
journeys.beforeProbe: Record the project draft summary and updatedAt, and the caseStudyMetadata status, evidenceStatus and updatedAt.
journeys.afterProbe: Read the same draft and metadata and compare summary, status and evidenceStatus with the recorded values; record the timestamps.
journeys.cleanup: Save the recorded original summary and confirm it is restored. Residual effects, recorded in the evidence: the draft updatedAt and the caseStudyMetadata updatedAt advance, because the save handler always stamps a new time; status and evidenceStatus must equal the recorded values.

journeys.behavior: An authorized operator saves the public WhatsApp URL; the screen blocks an invalid URL and the server rejects one sent directly, without writing.
preconditions: An authorized existing Better Auth browser session for the dashboard operator exists; login is never automated and no profile is created.
Runs on local or preview only; production stays read-only.

A PUBLIC_WHATSAPP_URL setting already exists for the environment (the preview seed creates it) and its value is recorded before the run; without one the run stops, because settings cannot be deleted from the dashboard.
steps: Open /dashboard/settings with the existing session.
Type an invalid URL such as http://example.com and observe that saving is blocked.
Save a valid direct wa.me URL.
Restore the recorded value.
expectedResults: The screen blocks the invalid value and the host probe's direct invalid mutation is rejected; the setting updatedAt does not change.
The valid value saves and updatedAt advances.
After cleanup the value equals the recorded original.
journeys.beforeProbe: Record the setting value and updatedAt; then, with the operator's Convex JWT, call content.upsertSiteSetting directly with http://example.com and record the rejection.
journeys.afterProbe: Read the setting and compare value and updatedAt with the expected values.
journeys.cleanup: Save the recorded original value and confirm it is restored. Residual effect, recorded in the evidence: the setting updatedAt advances, because the save handler always stamps a new time.

journeys.launch: DASHBOARD_URL on a versioned *.aohys-com.pages.dev preview origin (the Pages guard does not run on the local Vite server)
journeys.behavior: A signed-in account outside the ADMIN_EMAIL allowlist is refused by the Pages guard and by Convex.
preconditions: An existing Better Auth browser session for an account outside the allowlist exists; login is never automated.
Preview only: the 403 comes from the Cloudflare Pages guard, which the local Vite server does not run.
steps: Open /dashboard with the denied session and record the HTTP status and page.
Open /dashboard/resume with the same session.
Capture screenshots, console and network observations.
expectedResults: The Pages guard returns 403 with the not-allowed page and no dashboard shell or data loads.
The host Convex probe rejects with 'This account is not allowed to use the dashboard.'
Nothing is written.
journeys.beforeProbe: Host probe: with the denied session, request a Convex JWT from /api/auth/convex/token, call the read-only Convex query content:listForDashboard with that JWT and record the error (credential values stay private); record the /dashboard response status.
journeys.afterProbe: Repeat the same Convex call and /dashboard request and assert both are unchanged (rejection and 403).

journeys.behavior: A visitor sees the contact form, and an invalid submission is rejected by the server before any write.
preconditions: Runs on local or preview only; production stays read-only.
A valid submission (stored lead and notification email) is not part of this journey because a lead cannot be removed afterwards; the release smoke covers it when SMOKE_CONTACT_SUBMIT is enabled.
steps: Open /contact/ and /es/contacto/ as an anonymous visitor.
Observe the form fields and the intent options.
Capture screenshots, console and network observations.
expectedResults: Both forms render with the five intent options.
The host probe receives 400 validation_error and no lead is created.
journeys.beforeProbe: Host probe: record the newest lead createdAt before any request; then POST /contact on the backend site URL once with a shape-valid, run-unique payload and intent 'bogus', and record the status and body.
journeys.afterProbe: Read the newest leads and assert none was created after the baseline and none carries the run-unique marker; the recorded response must be 400 validation_error.

journeys.behavior: An authorized operator publishes saved drafts to preview and follows the durable publication request to a deployed receipt.
preconditions: An authorized existing Better Auth browser session for the dashboard operator exists; login is never automated and no profile is created.
Preview only. Publishing dispatches the release workflow and deploys Cloudflare Pages, so every run needs the owner's explicit authorization for that operation.

Before the run, every draft in the publication scope is already published (publishedAt set, no pending edits) and matches the deployed preview; otherwise the run stops, so cleanup never exposes unrelated pending edits.
The drafts and media states in the publication scope are snapshotted before the run.
steps: Save a run-unique marker in one project or resume draft so the publication content differs from every earlier request.
Publish from the dashboard with the existing session and record the requestKey and publicationAttemptId returned.
Confirm that requestKey and attempt were created by this run (not an earlier deployed request returned for unchanged content).
Follow that attempt until the release receipt is recorded.
Open the preview site and confirm the run-unique marker is published.
expectedResults: This run creates a new request and attempt; an existing deployed request returned for unchanged content does not count.
The new request moves to release-requested and then deployed with a receipt; a failed run ends release-failed or rollback-needed and is never retried from elapsed time.
The preview site shows the run-unique marker.
journeys.beforeProbe: Record the latest publication request key and state, to tell this run's request from earlier ones.
journeys.afterProbe: Read the request and attempt identified by this run's requestKey and publicationAttemptId, and their receipt; earlier requests never count as this run's result.
journeys.cleanup: Restore the snapshotted drafts and media states and publish them again with the owner's authorization, returning preview to the pre-run deployed content; publication records are kept.
